subject: 60-day OKR risk triage + operations asks
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara@acmeanalytics.com>, Procurement Ops <procure@horizoncorp.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: 60-day OKR risk triage + operations asks

Team —

Quick 60-day pulse and a set of ops asks so we can lock the QBR narrative by next Friday. High-level summary first, details + asks below. Attached: OKR_60Day_Readout_v1.pdf and Q3_re-scope_proposals.xlsx.

TL;DR
- Overall progress: on-track on 2/5 outcome metrics, partial on 2, at-risk on 1 (Latency SLO improvement).
- Biggest risk: serving capacity for long-sequence workloads causing latency regressions (affects Gen and Chat routes).
- Proposed re-scope: defer interactive long-session feature (OKR 1.3) to next quarter; concentrate on batching/kv-cache improvements and telemetry.

By-OKR notes (high level)
1) Latency & throughput (OKR-1) — AT RISK
   - Root cause: traffic mix shift + KV cache misses for >2k token sessions.
   - Proposed: narrow rollout to canary regions + extra caching (see sheet).
   - Ask (Karthik): temporary dedicated pool increase of 2x for gen-heavy pods for 3 weeks OR fallback to quantized variant. ETA decision: 72h.

2) Cost per token (OKR-2) — PARTIAL
   - Progress with batching heuristics. Need SRE test run to validate production gains.
   - Ask (Karthik): a small perf job on staging with representative traffic (INF-4321). ETA: 5 business days.

3) Customer rollout & support readiness (OKR-3) — ON-TRACK
   - CS playbook in draft.
   - Ask (Marissa): confirm support coverage for upcoming limited rollouts (2 FTEs overlap). Deadline: EOD Tue.

4) Security/compliance gating (OKR-4) — ON-TRACK
   - Procure asked for updated SOC2 doc; Procurement Ops copied. (Procurement, please acknowledge receipt.)

Proposed re-scope (see attached spreadsheet): remove experimental long-session UI gating from Q3 deliverables; prioritize infra controls + telemetry that reduce incident blast radius. This keeps our user-facing promises but buys runway.

Concrete asks (summary)
- Karthik: decision on temporary dedicated pool increase OR automated fallback to quantized model (reply with chosen path + rough ETA).
- Marissa: confirm CS coverage and one-sentence escalation play for customers who hit latency regressions.
- Vivek: permission to reallocate two hiring slates (one infra SRE, one infra SW eng) from Q4 to immediate headcount requisition if we escalate. This would accelerate the permanent fix.

Deadline: please reply with commitments by Mon 2026-09-21 09:00 PT so I can finalize the QBR deck. If we can't get answers, we'll default to the conservative re-scope in tab 'Plan B' of the spreadsheet.

Thanks —
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
VP Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: OKR_60Day_Readout_v1.pdf (summary slides), Q3_re-scope_proposals.xlsx (detailed options)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: 60-day OKR risk triage + operations asks

Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear rundown. Short answers up front: we can do the temporary pool increase, but with caveats; we can also enable an automated fallback path to the 8-bit quantized variant. Notes below.

Notes / constraints:
- Capacity: adding 2x dedicated capacity for gen-heavy pods is feasible in hosted and dedicated clusters, but procurement lead time for Dedicated GPUs in some regions is 48–72h to route. For Hosted we can spin up burst capacity using spare cloud quota in ~6–12h (higher cost).
- Fallback: The quantized variant is validated for functional parity on most prompts; however, we need a quick smoke test for edge-case hallucination rates. That test can run in staging in ~2 business days if CS can freeze the canary traffic set.
- Perf job: I can run the perf job on staging (INF-4321). I'll need a representative traffic trace — please confirm which date range to use.

Proposed immediate plan (my recommendation):
1) Spin up hosted burst capacity in region-us (6–12h) to protect production while we run the staging perf job.
2) Run quantized fallback smoke tests (2 business days). If smoke passes, enable auto-fallback for long-seq sessions.
3) If fallback shows regression, we proceed with temporary dedicated pool while we kick off hiring for permanent infra work.

Commitments:
- Karthik: I'll kick off the hosted burst by EOD today and start perf job once you confirm trace (ETA results: 48–72h).
- For the temporary Dedicated pool, I need Procurement Ops' support (copied) to prioritize the request.

Quoted original for context:
> TL;DR
> - Overall progress: on-track on 2/5 outcome metrics, partial on 2, at-risk on 1 (Latency SLO improvement).

I'll follow up with a short status update in ~48h.

— Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer

Stephanie / Karthik —

We will hold the full customer-facing rollout for the long-session feature and enable a reduced canary as you suggested. I'll assign 2 FTEs for overlap coverage for the first two weeks of rollout and produce a one-page escalation runbook by EOD Tue. Attached: cs_rollout_checklist.docx (draft).

Request for Karthik: please include the expected error modes the fallback will produce (timeout vs degraded content) so CS can script the customer-facing responses.

— Marissa
Director, Customer Success

Thanks all for the quick responses — consolidated plan below so I can finalize the QBR deck. I'm attaching the updated slides that will go into the leadership readout (final deck link also below).

Decisions made:
- Short-term mitigation: Karthik to spin hosted burst capacity in region-us (actioned 2026-09-18).
- Fallback path: Run quantized fallback smoke tests; if green, enable auto-fallback for long-seq sessions. (Karthik ETA: 48–72h).
- Rollout gating: Marissa will run a reduced canary with 2 FTE overlap and deliver the escalation runbook by EOD Tue.
- Hiring escalation: Vivek approved initiating the two requisitions (infra SRE + infra SW engineer) to close the permanent gap; we'll route via Procurement Ops for prioritization.

Next steps / owners:
- Karthik: perf results + smoke test results into INF-4321 (due 2026-09-21 17:00 PT).
- Marissa: escalation runbook + canary outcomes (due 2026-09-22 09:00 PT).
- Vivek / Procurement: prioritize Dedicated pool request for fallback if needed.
- Stephanie: I'll publish the QBR readout by 2026-09-23 and circulate to execs.
